issue.body:
## Problem

`sample-kit check` cannot read the report files the upstream checker writes. A report is a series of sections, each ending with a line `=== END OF <NAME> ===`, and the last line is a JSON object with a `verdict` field.

## Fix

Add `parseReport(text)` that returns `{ sections: { <NAME>: <body> }, verdict: <the verdict value> }`.

## Done when

- [ ] `parseReport` returns every section by name and the final verdict.
- [ ] A test parses a fixture report with two sections.

pr.title: feat(sample-kit): parse upstream checker reports
pr.body: Adds parseReport and a fixture-based test.
